title: define and endef hold a list of commands
objective: Put three commands into a single define variable and run them all from the recipe with one $(name) reference.
hint: define name and endef wrap as many lines as you like; the variable is the whole block. Using it as a recipe line runs each of those lines in turn.

steps.description: one $(report) reference ran all three commands

name: makeling

version: 1.0
